newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra's Monfort upgrading cattle plant.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra's Monfort upgrading cattle plant.

text.p: ConAgra Inc's Monfort Beef plant in Garden City, Kan. will be closed the rest of this week for remodeling, a company official said.
"We are expanding and further modernizing the kill floor and that will allow us to increase capacity and harvest additional by-product value," said K.T. Miller, ConAgra spokeswoman.
When it reopens on Monday, the plant will have been shut down a total of 10 days, Miller said.

Miller would not disclose how much daily slaughter capacity would be increased at the plant. Trade sources estimated daily slaughter capacity at the Garden City plant at 3,600 head before the remodeling.
